Broad simple silhouettes and clear chapel geometry suitable for later low resolution framing.
Style must match reference graphic novel artwork rather than pixel art. Both images wide, approximately 1.9:1 each. No border within a panel, fill panel to edge. No mother character, no literal devil, no supernatural effects. Only these two scenes.
